Maya Patel: Quick async qtr check — dropping a micro update thread for OKR milestone Q3 inference (owners, shipped/slipped, blockers, next steps). Please reply with one-liners. :eyes:

Samir Khan: Shipped — autoscale policy UI + API (PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145) :ship: Staging perf +8%, small docs pushed.

Lee Chen: Slipped — runtime patch caused intermittent OOM on long-seq workloads (KV cache pointer issue). Rolling back the hotfix now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Lee Chen — rollback runtime-v2-hotfix -> runtime-v2@2026-07-14. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234

Lee Chen: ETA for rollback + verification ~ 90m. Need someone to hold canary traffic in us-west-2 and watch latency.

Jon Alvarez: I can hold canary until verification done. Ping me when traffic routed.

Nora Singh: Product dependency: embeddings batcher refactor depends on runtime fix. If rollback lands, we can resume canary tomorrow AM. Marking owner: @Nora Singh -> will sync with data.

Priya Rao: Noted. I'll deprioritize non-critical telemetry changes this sprint. Data team — can you confirm bandwidth for canary tomorrow?

Samir Khan: Quick FYI — autoscale docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/autoscale. If rollback blocks autoscale, use manual scale command:
```
redwoodctl scale pool --name=dedicated-gpu --replicas=4
```

DataBot: Data-team availability poll added. @data-team please update: https://polls.redwood.ai/p/486

Priya Rao: Thanks — will follow up in morning stand. For OKR tracking, tagging milestone: Q3::Milestone-3. Owners consolidated: Samir (autoscale), Lee (runtime), Nora (embeddings). Next steps: rollback verification, unblock embeddings, schedule canary.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Please add any PR links or short blockers before EOD. If nothing new, I'll compile and send to execs tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
